The two corrected scores are signed-error correction diagnostics, not original BCA, calibrated uncertainty bounds, conservative lower confidence bounds, or approved production methods. Their regressions used other development episodes' simulator-return labels. Original BCA/distance controls did not receive those labels; their comparisons here are descriptive, not a fair claim of deployable algorithm superiority.

There is no conditional Monte Carlo return sampling noise in these authenticated deterministic continuations. They are numerical values, not certified exact real arithmetic. Q1's smoothed lagged-policy TD target may differ from current frozen-actor V. U remains a twin-min one-step residual proxy, not a Q1-error coverage guarantee.
Numerical first-near-max selection is offset-sensitive; saved predictions/scores were not recentered and outcomes never break score ties.
All ambiguous episodes and all unthresholded gains remain in the paired primary mean; win/loss labels are descriptive only.
